Platinous J Series
Product catalog summary
Overview: The Platinous J Series by ESPEC CORP. is a line of advanced environmental test chambers designed for precise temperature and humidity control. These chambers are known for their energy efficiency, reliability, and user-friendly features, making them popular worldwide.
Key Features:
Energy Efficiency: The series features a new cooling system and PID control, significantly reducing power consumption.
Networking Capabilities: Equipped with N-instrumentation for easy networking, remote monitoring, and control via a web application.
Customization and Options: Offers a wide range of options and improved installation procedures for customization.
Specifications and Configurations:
Includes models like High Temperature & Humidity Chambers, Low Humidity Chambers, and Clean Temperature & Humidity Chambers.
Specifications cover a range of temperature and humidity controls, with detailed charts for different models.
Energy Saving Features:
Smart Refrigerator and Dehumidifier System with PID control optimizes energy use.
Additional savings through a sub-refrigeration circuit and optional DC inverter for low-temperature operations.
Communication and Control:
Remote monitoring and control via Ethernet connections, with features like email alerts and data logging.
Additional Tools:
Pattern Manager Lite software for program editing and data logging.
Test Navi website for access to environmental test standards and downloadable test profiles.
Installation and Maintenance: Detailed installation requirements and maintenance notifications ensure optimal performance and longevity.
Specifications and Features:
Temperature and humidity control system with a DC inverter energy-saving system, achieving high precision across a wide range.
Energy savings up to 70% depending on series and conditions.
Maintenance and Safety:
Easy maintenance options and compliance with international safety standards.
Advanced Features:
Online diagnostics services and backtrace functions for troubleshooting.
Installation Requirements: Specific space allocations for maintenance and operation, with recommendations for clearances.
Performance and Construction:
Balanced temperature and humidity control system with specific fluctuation and gradient parameters.
Construction materials include stainless steel for durability.
Models and Capacities:
Models identified as PL, PSL, PHP, PDR, PDL, PCR, and PU, offering capacities from 120L to 800L.
Recommendations:
Maintain ambient conditions within specified limits for optimal performance.
Regular maintenance of systems is recommended for longevity and efficiency.
Conclusion: The document provides comprehensive information on specifications, performance, and operational guidelines for ultra-low temperature chambers, emphasizing adherence to specified conditions and safety features for efficient operation.

Characteristics All-glass wide-view door
An all-glass wide-view door provides an unrestricted view of every bit of space inside the chamber. This option is the optimum choice when observation of or operations on a specimen are required during testing. The entire surface of the door is made of multi-layer EC (metal film deposition) glass that withstands temperatures from -40 to +120ºC (+100ºC when hand-in ports are equipped). Temperature differential with the outside of the chamber can be controlled to suppress the formation of condensation on the glass surface.
